gloss: to butter up; to flatter; to suck up

definitions.gloss: to butter up; to flatter; to suck up to someone
definitions.explanation: To try to gain favor from someone in a position of authority through excessive flattery or ingratiating behavior. A colloquial and slightly negative expression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ごまをする。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ごまをすって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He's always sucking up to the teacher.

examples.japanese: ごまをすった⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧わけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: It's not like flattery will get her promoted, but she changes her attitude in front of the department head.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
The expression comes from the act of grinding sesame seeds (ごまをする) in a mortar. The seeds stick to everything around them, just as a flatterer "sticks" to people in power. A person who flatters is called a ごま⟦すり→すり：01330_suri⟧.

USAGE:
This is an informal expression with a somewhat negative connotation. It implies that the flattery is insincere and motivated by self-interest. The person doing the flattering is often viewed critically by others.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ごまをする (to butter up [person])
- ごまをすって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is sucking up; note the ⟦って→って：29146_tte⟧ contraction)
- ごま⟦すり→すり：01330_suri⟧ (noun: flatterer, sycophant)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ごまをする: to butter up (informal, somewhat negative)
- ⟦おべっか→おべっか：07885_obekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use flattery (slightly more formal)
- ⟦{媚|こ}び→媚びる：09028_kobiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to sell one's charm (stronger negative nuance)
- ⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to try to please (more neutral)
